C1315.title: Proofpoint Detects Large-Scale AiTM Phishing Attack Bypassing MFA
C1315.summary: In April 2025, Proofpoint detected a large-scale AiTM phishing attack leveraging the Tycoon 2FA platform, targeting thousands of organizations globally. The attack used highly realistic Microsoft 365 authentication pages to capture user credentials, 2FA tokens, and session cookies in real time, successfully bypassing MFA. Evasion techniques included invisible Unicode characters and custom CAPTCHAs

references.title: Evolving Threat: Microsoft AiTM Phishing Attacks | Proofpoint US
